# Development ecosystem snapshots

These MIT npm-format archives keep local showcase verification reproducible without sibling repositories or publication. They are development dependencies and excluded from the published VibeSocket package. Captured from the supplied local ecosystem working trees on 2026-10-28; no claim is made that unpublished working-tree snapshots are released upstream versions. Licenses/notices are inside each archive.
